svg.text: Coffee Bean Cup Cosy — colourwork chart
Worked in the round: every round read right to left, bottom to top. Gauge 22 sts × 30 rnds = 10 cm; cells drawn at that proportion (wider than tall),
so the beans on the chart look as they will in the fabric. Cast on 56 sts, work 4 rnds k2p2 rib, the 26 chart rnds, 4 rnds rib, bind off.
CC coffee brown — knit (cream crease runs through each bean)
Repeat sts 1–8 seven times per round (56 sts ≈ 25.5 cm). Beans ≈ 2.7 cm wide × 3.7 cm tall; second tier offset by half a repeat. Longest float 4 sts — no trapping needed.
